name: Engine Mounts
description: Engine mounts and block-side brackets to the front cradle.

components.name: Engine mounts (L & R)
components.description: Hydraulic/rubber isolator mounts between the block brackets and the front cradle (K-member). The ZL1 uses a supercharged-specific driver-side mount. Road-race cars switch to poly or solid mounts to stop engine roll from upsetting shifts and header/hood clearance.
components.location: Each side of the block, low and near mid-length, sitting on the front cradle mount pads.

factory.name: GM engine mount (2017-2024 Camaro 6.2L supercharged)
factory.notes: Listed as driver-side mount "with supercharger". Verify passenger side PN by VIN.

raceOptions.name: BMR MM362 motor mount kit with integrated stands, solid 6061 billet bushings
raceOptions.notes: 1.75 in DOM tube, grade 8 hardware; 2016-2024 Camaro V8.

raceOptions.name: BMR MM010 motor mount kit, 95A polyurethane bushings

hardware.notes: Summit lists "engine mount bolts 43 ft-lb" for Gen V; which joint it covers is not stated. Checked 2026-10: the TightTorque table compiled from the 2016-2018 Camaro service manual lists the LT1 'engine mount bracket fastener' at 58 N·m (43 lb ft). Summit gives 43 ft-lb. Remains typical.

Verify with GM service information / BMR instructions. Checked 2026-10: no Gen 6 GM or BMR value was found. The BMR MM009/MM010 sheets give no torque. They use 15 mm-head bolts (M10) for the mount-to-cradle plate and a 24 mm nut on the mount stud, so check the thread size before applying 50 ft-lb. Still an estimate.

installNotes: Lower engine/trans as a unit; start all mount fasteners before torquing.
Check header, steering shaft and oil-pan clearance at full engine rock after solid mounts.
inspection: Check mount bolts torque-stripe and bushing condition each event.

components.name: Engine mount brackets (block side)
components.description: Cast/steel brackets bolted to the block sides that carry the mounts. BMR MM362 replaces bracket and mount with integrated tubular stands.
components.location: Sides of block, low, near the front-to-mid of the block.

hardware.notes: Using Summit "engine mount bolts" value; verify. Checked 2026-10: TightTorque table compiled from the 2016-2018 Camaro service manual lists the LT1 'engine mount bracket fastener' at 58 N·m (43 lb ft), consistent with Summit's 'engine mount bolts 43 ft-lb'.

installNotes: Install on the engine stand before engine goes in the car.
